config_contents.name: sep_ondj
config_contents.description: Rainfall-amount bias-correction benchmark: September-initialized ECMWF SEAS5, ONDJ season and its calendar months, every 0.25 deg cell of Ethiopia (docs/47).

protocol:
Benchmark rainfall-amount bias-correction methods member by member, for every grid cell and target (docs/47).

Read-only experiment: never touches the operational forecasts. Configured by config/bias_correction/<name>.json.

Designs (one score per year: area-weighted over a region; years weighted equally):
  training    : leave-one-year-out within 1993-2016; the target year never enters a fit (clean, gated)
  operational : fit on 1993-2016, scored on 2017-2024 (exploratory; these years were seen before)
  full        : leave-one-year-out within 1993-2024, for per-cell maps and distribution checks (descriptive)
  forecast    : fit on 1993-2024, corrected 2026 members of every method (member-by-member comparison)
Scores: fair ensemble CRPS (mm) and CRPSS against the CHIRPS training climatology; ensemble-mean bias, MAE,
RMSE and correlation; spread-error ratio; rank (PIT) histograms; tercile RPS/RPSS of alpha-smoothed member
counts (no climatology blend); distribution of the pooled corrected members against CHIRPS (mean, standard
deviation, 10/50/90th percentiles and zero fraction).
Gate: each method against the reference (operational MVS), the docs/36 rule: CRPS (amounts) and RPS
(probabilities) per year, one-sided sign-flip p, Holm across the targets, no harm in 2017-2024.
gate_rule:
Adoption rule, fixed in docs/36 before the gated comparisons were run.

    Adopt the candidate for a target only if, on clean nested 1993-2016 scores,
    it improves the mean with Holm-adjusted one-sided p < ALPHA across the five
    targets, AND on 2017-2025 its mean score is not worse than the reference.

raw.label: Raw ECMWF (no correction)
raw.definition: x' = x (the uncorrected model; baseline, not a candidate)

ls.label: Linear Scaling
ls.definition: x' = x * mu_obs / mu_model (multiplicative mean correction)

mvs.label: Mean-Variance Scaling (operational)
mvs.definition: x' = max(0, mu_obs + r (x - mu_model)), r = clip(sd_obs/sd_model, 0.5, 2); r = 1 if sd_model < 1 mm

vs.label: Variance Scaling (unbounded)
vs.definition: Same algebra as MVS without the project's ratio limits: r = sd_obs/sd_model

sqrt_mvs.label: Square-root-space Mean-Variance Scaling
sqrt_mvs.definition: MVS applied to sqrt(x), clipped at 0 and squared back (docs/36)

pt.label: Power Transformation
pt.definition: x' = a x^b, b matches the coefficient of variation, a the mean

dc.label: Delta Change
dc.definition: Training-year CHIRPS totals times (forecast ensemble mean / model climatological mean)

loci.label: Local Intensity Scaling
loci.definition: Model wet threshold with the observed wet frequency, then intensity scaling above it

gqm.label: Gamma Quantile Mapping
gqm.definition: x' = G_obs^-1(G_model(x)), mixed dry mass + gamma, weighted maximum likelihood

dqm.label: Detrended Quantile Mapping
dqm.definition: EQM of x / a, times a, with a = forecast ensemble mean / model mean

qdm.label: Quantile Delta Mapping
qdm.definition: x' = Q_obs(tau) * x / Q_model(tau), tau = rank of x in the forecast ensemble

sdm.label: Scaled Distribution Mapping
sdm.definition: Gamma fits to observations, model climatology and forecast ensemble; scaled relative change and rain frequency

cdft.label: CDF-transform
cdft.definition: F_obs,f = F_obs(F_model^-1(F_forecast)); x' = F_obs,f^-1(F_forecast(x)); model first scaled to the observed mean
